b'# tinydl

A small command line downloader.

## Usage

```
tinydl URL [options]
```

`tinydl` downloads the resource at `URL` and writes the bytes to a file or to
standard output.

## Command line options

| Option | Help text |
| --- | --- |
| `url` | what to download |
| `-o`, `--output` | file to write (default: stdout) |
| `-q`, `--quiet` | no progress output |

### Positional arguments

**`url`** \xe2\x80\x94 what to download

### Optional arguments

**`-o`, `--output`** \xe2\x80\x94 file to write (default: stdout)

**`-q`, `--quiet`** \xe2\x80\x94 no progress output
'
